cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I pay the builder, will you sign that my fence can stay on our boundary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write it for you: 'The fence can stay.' Add your name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can change your mind. Date today's permission; I'll bring the form back if you do.

reason: A takes the writing and explicitly preserves later change while securing a dated current permission; remove the invented builder-invoice rule and mechanism summary.
